title: The last leaf
logline: The maple by the tavern's back door with one leaf on it, November 30, and the page waiting with it. The pup looking up. The leaf still on when the page ends.

panels.composition: A bare maple beside a tavern's back door with a single yellow leaf still on it, a small three-legged dog looking up at it from the alley.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a bare maple tree beside a tavern's back door with a single yellow leaf still on it and a small three-legged dog looking up at it from a gravel alley, no words
